theater: 金陵城與長江下游江防

battle.name: 宋滅南唐之戰
battle.theater: 金陵城與長江下游江防
battle.brief: 開寶七年九月，宋太祖以李煜拒絕入朝為由，下詔命曹彬率水陸軍十萬討南唐；十月出師荊南，連取鄂州、江州、池州、太平州，並依樊若水之策在石牌口結竹為浮橋，渡江直抵金陵。開寶八年二月十七日城破，李煜出降，南唐亡。卡面埃及長矛並未隨軍東來，其形制所對應的，正是此役中結陣拒騎、守城壓制的長矛步卒。

kit.name: 埃及長矛
kit.history: 早王朝時期的長矛，銅或青銅矛頭綁在木杆上。埃及人用它守城垣，後來也用它收復失地。

countries: 開寶七年宋滅南唐之戰，交戰的兩方是北宋與南唐。北宋方面，趙匡胤自建隆元年受周恭帝禪位，即定下先南後北、各個擊破的次序，事前已在江、淮、荊、湖、兩浙一線經營了十四年。此役北面主帥是曹彬，潘美、曹翰、符彥超各當一路，樊若水以幕僚身分主持渡江工程；禁軍步軍與騎軍為骨幹，另有自荊南、襄陽徵發的鄉兵與水軍舟師，吳越王錢俶奉詔率兵五萬助攻，由東南方向牽制配合。南唐方面，都金陵，以李璟、李煜父子相繼為主，樞密院掌軍政，侍衛軍與各州鎮兵為主力，江北有向後周割讓後的十四州作屏障，江南則倚長江天險與密集水網自守，城防集中在長江南岸的城垣、砲位與江中水寨。兩軍的編制同屬唐末五代以來的中原與江南軍制傳統，兵甲、旅製與砲具大致相近，真正拉開差距的是後勤與工程能力：宋軍有北方漕運與連續攻城的經驗，唐軍則久未與大軍正面交鋒。關於此役的史料，主要靠《資治通鑑》卷二百七十九、《宋史》本傳與《南唐書》《十國春秋》互相對勘，雙方數字常有出入。
countriesEn: The two belligerents in the campaign that destroyed the Southern Tang in 974 were the Northern Song and the Southern Tang. On the Song side, Zhao Kuangyin, who had taken the abdication of the last Later Zhou emperor in 960, pursued unification in the fixed order of southern first and northern second, and had spent fourteen years consolidating the Jiang, Huai, Jing, Hu and Liangzhe region before this campaign. The field commander was Cao Bin, with Pan Mei, Cao Han and Fu Yanchuo each commanding a wing, while Fan Ruoshui joined the staff and took charge of the engineering of the river crossing. The imperial guards, foot and horse alike, formed the core of the force, supplemented by local levies conscripted in Jingnan and Xiangyang and by a river flotilla; the king of Wuyue, Qian Chu, was summoned by edict to bring fifty thousand men to assist and to press the southern flank. The Southern Tang, with its capital at Jinling, was ruled in turn by Li Jing and his son Li Yu. Its Directorate of Military Affairs handled war affairs, the guard armies and the troops of the prefectures made up its fighting force, and the fourteen prefectures ceded to the Later Zhou formed its northern screen, while the south relied on the Yangtze and a dense water network, with its fortified line concentrated in the walls, artillery positions and river stockades along the southern bank. Both armies inherited the military organisation of the late Tang and the Five Dynasties, so their armour, unit system and artillery were broadly alike; what really separated them was logistics and engineering. The Song army drew on northern canal transport and on the experience of repeated sieges, whereas the Tang army had not faced a great army in the open field for years. The record of this campaign can only be reconstructed by collating the Comprehensive Mirror in Aid of Governance, volume 279, the Song History, the History of the Southern Tang and the Spring and Autumn of the Ten Kingdoms, and the two sides rarely agree on their numbers.
people: 這一戰的關鍵人物分列南北。北方策劃者是宋太祖趙匡胤：開寶七年九月他下詔數南唐之罪，遣使告以大軍將自江、鄂直抵金陵，明言不從的後果；十月正式命曹彬將水陸軍十萬出師，並採納樊若水的渡江之策。曹彬是全軍主帥，他最大的功勞不在斬將，而在紀律與工程：約束諸軍不得妄殺、不得縱掠，金陵城破之日下令禁屠城，使江南免去無謂的報復性屠殺。樊若水原為南唐將吏，降宋後以實測江面寬度、結竹為浮橋的辦法，解決了如何越過鐵索封江這個大難題，是全役的技術關鍵。南唐一方，樞密使皇甫繼勳與一批宿將主持城防與江防，屢次在浮橋與水寨方向反擊；水軍主帥朱令贇奉後主之命，領水軍十餘萬順流東下援救金陵，至皖口一線遭伏而全軍覆沒，朱令贇本人中流失死在亂軍之中。宰相潘佑、湯悅等人力主出降或退保，後主李煜猶豫不決，一再拖延議和與退守的時間，最終在開寶八年二月城破後奉表出降。吳越王錢俶以附宋之功保住封國，也藉此役為日後納土歸宋鋪了路。
peopleEn: The decisive figures of this campaign stand at either end of the Yangtze. The planner on the northern side was the Song emperor Zhao Kuangyin. In the ninth month of the Kaibao era, year seven, he issued an edict enumerating the crimes of the Southern Tang and sent envoys to announce that a great army would come straight from the Jiang and E regions to Jinling, making plain what refusal would bring; in the tenth month he formally ordered Cao Bin to lead one hundred thousand soldiers of water and land against the Tang, and he accepted Fan Ruoshui's plan for crossing the river. Cao Bin was the commander in chief, and his greatest achievement lay not in killing enemy generals but in discipline and engineering: he held the various contingents to the prohibition on wanton killing and on plunder, and on the day Jinling fell he forbade the sack of the city, so that the south escaped the pointless reprisal massacres that usually followed. Fan Ruoshui had been an officer of the Southern Tang; after defecting to Song he solved the great problem of how to cross a river sealed off with iron chains by measuring the width of the water and binding bamboo into a floating bridge, and he was the technical key of the whole campaign. On the Southern Tang side, the Directorate chief Huangfu Jihxun and a group of veteran generals directed the defence of the city and of the river, and they counter-attacked more than once toward the floating bridge and the river stockades. The admiral Zhu Lingyun, acting on the orders of the last ruler, led more than one hundred thousand river troops downstream to relieve Jinling; at the Wankou line they walked into an ambush, the entire force was destroyed, and Zhu Lingyun himself was struck by a stray arrow and trampled to death in the rout. Ministers such as Pan You and Tang Yue pressed for surrender or for a withdrawal, but the last ruler Li Yu hesitated, delaying again and again the negotiations and the decision to fall back, and in the end, after the city fell in the second month of the Kaibao era, year eight, he presented a surrender petition. Qian Chu, king of Wuyue, preserved his fief by aiding the Song, and this campaign in fact paved the way for his later voluntary surrender of Wuyue.
kits: 此戰的兵器體系仍帶唐末五代的樣貌，卡面那件埃及長矛自然不在軍中，但它對應的形制——銅或青銅矛頭綁在木杆、以長杆結陣——正是當時步軍的骨幹。埃及人於早王朝以長矛守城垣、收復失地；到了十世紀的江淮，長杆兵器化為步軍結方陣、拒騎兵衝撞、並在城頭壓制攀城者的工具，宋軍的步軍、槍手與弩手混成編隊，長矛居其前排，弓弩居其後，攻城一方倚賴的則是砲與火藥：宋軍有擡砲、發石機，以及以火藥填藥的震天雷、突火槍一類火器，火箭用來焚燒江面上南唐舟師的帆檣與艙板；守城一方在城頭列砲，用弓弩壓制浮橋上的先鋒。舟師方面，兩造都有走舸、鬥艦、蒙衝一類戰船，南唐更在江面以鐵索橫江、貫沉舟、施橫木並架砲，企圖封死水面通道。渡江的關鍵器械是浮橋：以竹索繫巨舟，承板橋三層，架於石牌口，馬步可以直接通過。糧秣則靠水運，軍糧自汴京沿汴河、淮河、揚州順流而下，再由池州轉運到江邊陣地。
kitsEn: The arms of this campaign still carried the look of the late Tang and the Five Dynasties. The Egyptian spear on the card face was of course not present in the army, but the form it stands for — a copper or bronze head bound to a wooden shaft, the long shaft used to form ranks — was exactly the backbone of the foot soldier of the day. The Egyptians had used the long spear to guard city walls and to recover lost ground in the Early Dynasties; by the tenth century in the Jiang and Huai the long shaft weapon had become the tool with which foot troops formed square ranks, withstood the charge of cavalry and pressed down on men climbing the walls from the ramparts. In the Song army the foot troops, spearmen and crossbowmen were intermingled, the long spears in the front rank and the bows and crossbows behind them, while the attacking side relied on artillery and gunpowder: the Song had traction trebuchets and stone-throwers, together with gunpowder weapons such as the thunder-crash bomb and the fire lance, and rockets were used to burn the sails and hulls of the Southern Tang war-junks on the river. The defenders answered with artillery emplaced on the walls and with bows and crossbows covering the vanguard on the floating bridge. On the water both sides used war-junks, fighting galleys and ram-ships; the Southern Tang went further, stretching iron chains across the river, threading them through sunken hulls and laying beams and artillery on top, in order to seal the waterway. The decisive instrument of the crossing was the floating bridge: bamboo cables mooring huge boats, carrying three tiers of planking, built at Shipaikou, so that horses and foot could walk straight over. Supplies came by water, the grain leaving Bianjing down the Bian canal, the Huai river and Yangzhou, and then being shifted inland from Chizhou to the staging grounds on the bank.
tactics: 北宋的戰法可以概括為四步：先以壓制性的進攻掃清江漢與皖贛之間的據點，斷南唐援軍與金陵的聯繫；再在長江下游選定架橋點，用浮橋硬把江防破開；接著分兵攻取池州、太平州，控制上游與東岸的基地；最後合圍金陵，先以砲火與火器摧毀城頭與城樓，再以雲梯、突梯近城，一鼓登城。南唐的應對則把金陵城與江防拆成兩個系統：江面以水寨、鐵索與舟師層層阻截，城的方面集中精兵與砲位固守，希望拖到宋軍疲憊、糧盡而自退。金陵城破之後，宋軍並未就此罷手，掃平江州、宣州等地的殘部：江州刺史謝彥賓在投降前被指揮使胡則所殺，胡則據城抵抗，直到開寶八年四月城破；昭武軍節度留後盧絳退保宣州，殺歙州刺史龔慎儀，憑山城固守，經宋太祖手詔勸降才開城。吳越軍則從東面沿海岸與山道推進，切斷南唐在浙東的退路。三路並進，最終把南唐在江南的抵抗逐段壓平。
tacticsEn: The Song method can be reduced to four steps. First a sweeping offensive cleared the strongholds between the Han and the Gan rivers, cutting the Southern Tang off from its reinforcements and from Jinling. Then a site was chosen below the Yangtze and a floating bridge was used to break the river screen by force. Next the forces split to take Chizhou and Taipingzhou, securing the upper reaches and the eastern shore as bases. Finally they closed around Jinling, first breaking the parapets and towers with stone and gunpowder, then bringing scaling ladders and assault ladders to the wall and storming the city in a single push. The Southern Tang answer was to split the city and the river defence into two separate systems: on the water, stockades, iron chains and war-junks checked the river in successive layers; in the city, picked troops and artillery emplacements held fast, in the hope of wearing the Song army down until its food ran out and it withdrew of its own accord. After Jinling fell the Song did not stop. The remnants were hunted down in Jiangzhou and Xuanzhou: the governor of Jiangzhou, Xie Yanbin, was killed by his own command officer Hu Ze before the surrender, Hu Ze then held the city in resistance until it was taken in the fourth month of the Kaibao era, year eight; and the deputy military governor of Zhaowu, Lu Jiang, withdrew to Xuanzhou, killed the governor of Shezhou, Gong Shenyi, and held the mountain city until a handwritten edict from the Song emperor persuaded him to open the gates. The Wuyue army advanced from the east along the coast and the hill tracks, cutting off the Southern Tang retreat in eastern Zhejiang. Three columns converging in this way finally crushed the Southern Tang resistance in the south, section by section.
data: 可核對的數字並不多，須逐一分辨。兵力方面，開寶七年十月出師時傳出的說法是水陸軍十萬，此數大致可信；吳越王錢俶奉詔所率之眾，通常記為五萬。南唐樞密使朱令贇自湖口順流而下的水軍，記為十餘萬，也有記載稱近十五萬，但這類號稱往往倍於實有，諸說並存，不可盡信。時間方面，自開寶七年十月出師到開寶八年二月十七日金陵城破，前後四個多月；若只計自正月兵臨城下到二月城破，圍城僅約一個月，說明宋軍並未把攻城拖成曠日持久的消耗。城防規模方面，金陵城牆周長與城樓數目，史料只有「城周二十餘里」一類概略說法，具體里數難以核實。南唐覆亡後，江南州縣在開寶八年四月至五月間陸續歸降，可見殘餘抵抗歷時約三四個月，與胡則、盧絳兩處的記載相合。滅亡的繫年，史籍多繫於開寶八年二月，另有繫於次年正月者，諸說並存。軍糧方面無可靠總數，只能從運糧的距離與航程推知，遠征江南完全依賴水運與船隊，故宋軍沿江所設的轉運點多集中在池州、太平州一帶。
dataEn: Few figures can be checked, and each has to be weighed separately. On strength, the number that went out with the army in the tenth month of the Kaibao era, year seven, was one hundred thousand of water and land, and that figure is broadly credible; the troops that Qian Chu, king of Wuyue, was summoned to bring are usually given as fifty thousand. The Tang river army under the admiral Zhu Lingyun, which came down the river from Hukou, is recorded at more than one hundred thousand, and other accounts put it near one hundred and fifty thousand, but such host figures were often double the men actually present, and the various statements stand side by side without one displacing the others. On timing, from the departure of the army in the tenth month of the Kaibao era, year seven, to the fall of Jinling on the seventeenth day of the second month of the year eight, four months and a little passed; counting only from the arrival before the walls in the first month to the breach in the second, the siege lasted only about a month, which shows that the Song had not let the siege degenerate into a long attritional war. On the scale of the defences, the circumference of the walls of Jinling and the number of towers survive only in vague statements of the kind that the city ran for more than twenty li, and no exact figure can be verified. After the fall of the Tang, the prefectures of the south capitulated one after another between the fourth and fifth months of the year eight, so the last resistance lasted about three or four months, which fits the separate records of Hu Ze and Lu Jiang. As for the date of the collapse itself, most chronicles place it in the second month of the Kaibao era, year eight, while others place it in the first month of the year following, and the two views coexist. There is no reliable total for the grain, and it can only be inferred from the distance and the sailing time of the transport; campaigning this far south depended entirely on water transport and on the flotilla, which is why the Song transfer points along the river clustered around Chizhou and Taipingzhou.
cause: 打起來的原因是多層的。第一層是宋的統一戰略：趙匡胤自960年建宋，即定下先南後北、各個擊破的次序，南唐地廣人稠、國力富足而重文輕兵，是最難啃的一塊。第二層是南唐自己的選擇：李煜即位後對宋既恭順又保持距離，開寶七年宋太祖詔令入朝，他稱疾不赴；同年十月宋使至金陵宣諭，措辭已帶兵威，及至十一月、十二月宋軍連下鄂州、江州、池州，唐廷才被迫議和，而和議又被拖延。第三層是雙方的實質矛盾：南唐既已割讓長江以北十四州給後周、向宋稱臣，卻仍保留國主的名號與宮殿儀制，971年被宋降稱江南國主並撤去宮殿鴟吻、諸王降封為公，開寶七年李煜索性不用宋年號而改用干支紀年，等於公開表示不臣；宋廷則把進攻解釋為救民，詔書指責南唐兵以精甲而事煩調發、民力困疲。表面是拒絕入朝，骨子裡是主權與體面的衝突：宋不能容忍一個仍以帝王自居的南方政權，李煜也不肯放棄國主的名分與都城。吳越、南漢、後蜀相繼平定，又讓宋在戰略上再無牽制，時間終於站在宋的一邊。
causeEn: The reasons for going to war lie on several levels. The first is the Song strategy of unification: from the founding of the dynasty in 960 Zhao Kuangyin had fixed the order of south first and north second, defeating one enemy at a time, and the Southern Tang, with its broad territory, rich resources and an army that valued literature and despised war, was the hardest of the lot. The second is the choice of the Southern Tang itself: after Li Yu took the throne he was at once deferential to the Song and careful to keep his distance, and when the Song emperor summoned him to court in the Kaibao era, year seven, he pleaded illness and did not come; in the tenth month of that year a Song envoy reached Jinling with a declaration that already carried the threat of force, and only after the Song army had taken E, Jiang and Chizhou in the eleventh and twelfth months did the Tang court begin to negotiate, and the negotiations were then allowed to drag. The third is the real contradiction between the two sides. The Southern Tang had already ceded the fourteen prefectures north of the Yangtze to the Later Zhou and had acknowledged the Song as overlord, yet it kept the title of ruler and the ceremonial of a court; in 971 the Song reduced it to the style of Prince of Jiangnan, stripped the gargoyles from its palace and demoted its princes to that of dukes; and in the Kaibao era, year seven, Li Yu simply stopped using the Song era name and reckoned the years by cyclical characters instead, which was an open declaration of independence. The Song court framed the attack as a rescue of the people, and the edict accused the Southern Tang of exhausting the people with a picked army and incessant levies. On the surface it was a refusal to come to court; underneath it was a collision of sovereignty and face. The Song could not tolerate a southern state that still styled itself imperial, and Li Yu would not surrender the name of ruler or the capital. The earlier reduction of Wuyue, Southern Han and Later Shu had by then left the Song free of strategic distraction, and time had finally come down on the side of the Song.
impact: 南唐的覆亡改變了江淮的行政格局。此後北宋直接統治江南，揚州、池州、潤州、昇州一線的州縣由割據政權改為朝廷直轄，鹽利、漕運與米糧調度自此歸入中央財政；華夏南北的分隔線也由長江退回到淮河與大散關一帶。對南唐的宮室與文教而言，李煜降宋後被封為違命侯，宮中所藏書畫彝器多數充入宋內府，成為後來宣和書畫收藏的源頭之一；李煜本人則從帝王變成詞人，《虞美人》《浪淘沙》那種亡國之音，反而在宋代文壇與後世文學史中佔據了極重要的位置。對南唐舊臣而言，翰林待詔之職成為降臣棲身之所，徐鉉、湯悅輩由此進入北宋文官體系。戰爭本身的代價也不小：金陵雖因曹彬約束而免於屠城，江淮地區仍經歷了兵禍、糧價騰貴與大批軍戶南逃的餘波；吳越與南唐相繼覆亡後，江南的割據傳統正式終結，宋朝自此面對的是一個完整卻並不安寧的南方。
impactEn: The fall of the Southern Tang changed the administrative shape of the Jiang and Huai. From then on the Northern Song governed the south directly, and the prefectures along the line of Yangzhou, Chizhou, Runzhou and Shengzhou passed from the hands of a separatist regime into those of the imperial court, while the salt tax, the canal transport and the movement of grain came under central finance; the line dividing north and south in China was pulled back from the Yangtze to the Huai river and the Dasan Pass. For the palace and the culture of the Southern Tang, Li Yu, once reduced to the Prince of Disobedience after his surrender, saw the paintings, books and ritual bronzes of his court absorbed into the Song imperial collection, one of the sources of the later Huizong collection, and he himself turned from an emperor into a poet; the songs of a ruined state such as the Yu Meiren and the Langtaosha came to occupy a very important place in the literature of the Song and in the history of later Chinese letters. For the former officials of the Tang, a post as a waiting scholar at the Hanlin Academy became the shelter of surrendered ministers, and men such as Xu Xuan and Tang Yue entered the civil service of the Northern Song in this way. The cost of the war was real as well. Jinling escaped the sack because Cao Bin held his men in check, yet the Jiang and Huai still went through the disorder of the campaign, the soaring price of grain and the flight southward of many military households. Once Wuyue and the Southern Tang had both fallen, the separatist tradition of the south came formally to an end, and the Song now faced a south that was complete, if not entirely settled.
result: 結果是南唐的完全覆亡。開寶八年二月十七日，宋軍在砲火與突梯攻破城頭之後攻入金陵，李煜奉表出降，宮中印記、圖籍、金帛盡為宋軍所取。掃平戰隨後拖到四月：江州由胡則據城抵抗，四月城破；宣州盧絳固守山城，經宋太祖手詔勸降後開城。吳越方向與南唐江南的反抗勢力接連瓦解，殘存州縣陸續歸降。李煜隨後奉表入汴京，被封為違命侯；南唐舊有的三省六部、樞密院與全套儀制隨之廢止，只保留唐國的名號作為歸順的形式。此役之後，五代十國只剩下北漢與吳越兩個政權：吳越於太平興國三年納土歸宋，北漢則在太平興國四年被宋太宗滅亡，南北分裂的格局才真正宣告結束。戰後江南的接管比攻城本身更見章法：各州縣印記、帳籍與兵械一併收繳，樞密院與侍衛軍編制隨之裁撤，舊臣多授以散秩或留任翰林；金陵的宮殿樓閣多數改作倉廩與署舍，城中秩序在數月之內恢復常態，漕船復航，鹽利重開。吳越見南唐既亡、 宋 勢 已 成， 也 自動 加 強 與 宋 的 聯繫， 三 年 之 後 錢俶 奉 表 納土。
resultEn: The result was the complete destruction of the Southern Tang. On the seventeenth day of the second month of the Kaibao era, year eight, after stone and gunpowder had broken the parapets and the assault ladders had been set against the wall, the Song army entered Jinling; Li Yu presented his surrender petition, and the seals, archives, gold and silk of the palace all fell into the hands of the Song troops. The mopping up dragged on into the fourth month: Hu Ze held Jiangzhou in resistance and the city fell in the fourth month, and Lu Jiang, who held the mountain city of Xuanzhou, opened the gates after a handwritten edict of the Song emperor persuaded him to surrender. The resistance in the Jiangnan south and the Wuyue front crumbled in turn, and the surviving prefectures capitulated one after another. Li Yu afterwards presented himself at Bianjing and was given the title Prince of Disobedience; the old three departments and six ministries of the Southern Tang, its Directorate of Military Affairs and the whole apparatus of court ceremonial were abolished, leaving only the name of the state of Tang as a form of submission. After this campaign only two of the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms remained, Northern Han and Wuyue: Wuyue handed over its territory to the Song in the third year of the Taiping Xingguo era, and Northern Han was destroyed by the Song emperor Taizong in the fourth year of the same era, and only then was the division between north and south truly brought to an end. The takeover of the south after the war was better ordered than the siege itself: the seals, the registers and the arms of the prefectures were taken over in one sweep, the Directorate of Military Affairs and the guard establishment were cut away, and the old officials were mostly given sinecure posts or kept on at the Hanlin Academy. Most of the palaces and halls of Jinling were converted into granaries and offices, the ordinary order of the city was restored within the space of a few months, the grain boats sailed again and the salt tax was reopened. Seeing the Southern Tang destroyed and the Song already firmly established, Wuyue drew closer to the Song of its own accord, and three years later Qian Chu presented a petition and handed over his territory.
